title: fix(rest)!: GET /meta/_drafts refuses an unknown type or package filter instead of answering an empty list (#29180)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9GbNZzHvo45yCpaxgdU2SJY)_
Fixes #29180

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — measured: on base `5ac557e5^` (`104cd1a5`) `_drafts?type=dashbord|dashboardes|viewes|nosuchtype` and `?packageId=com.qa.nosuch` answer `200 {"drafts":[]}` (the refusal pins below go red there); on head they answer `400 INVALID_REQUEST`, on both transports. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: none — measured: no spec key, value or type moves; `packages/spec` is untouched.
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` page or docs page documents the `_drafts` filters (the two docs mentions, `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` L455/L461, cite only its capability gate).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`GET /meta/_drafts` 的 `type` 写错(如 `dashbord`)或 `packageId` 指向不存在的包时，不再回 200 空列表，而是回 400,文案与列表门、诊断门对同一错误的拒绝一致。
- 为什么改:作者或 AI 在发布、回滚、丢弃前问"有没有待发布草稿",拼错就得到一个自信的"没有",随后按"无待办"行事。
- 风险与回滚：这是收窄(原先 200 的请求现在 400);正确的类型(单复数皆可)和已安装但无草稿的包仍回 200 空列表。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-drafts.ts`(包检查)、`packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts`(类型检查)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`(派发器孪生门)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-drafts-unknown-filter.test.ts`,预期 9 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Type** (`packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`): both `_drafts` doors ask `refuseUnknownMetaListType`, the list door's own verdict (static spelling contract, then the live type set, fail-open), before `listDrafts`. No second copy of the type vocabulary: it is the same function `GET /meta/:type` and `GET /meta/diagnostics?type=` call, so the drafts answer is pinned EQUAL to the list door's answer for the same name.
- **Package** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-drafts.ts`): `listDrafts` asks the diagnostics sweep's rule (`packageIsInstalled`, now exported from `protocol-meta-diagnostics.ts`; nothing re-exports that module, so the published surface does not move): an empty answer for a `packageId` that no pending draft (of any type) is bound to and that the installed-package listing does not carry is refused `400 INVALID_REQUEST`, same code and sentence family as the sweep's `is not an installed package`. Fails open when the listing cannot be read. Living in `listDrafts`, it covers both transports.
- `DraftsHost` gains `getMetaItems` (the class hands it over as the other moved bodies do); the method docblock names the refusal.
- No new error code, no new gate, no `packages/spec` edit.

## Tests

New files only; no existing test was edited (no forced test edits).

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-drafts-unknown-package.test.ts` (5): refusal (status + code + first clause naming the package, with and without `type`); controls: installed package with nothing pending (no type, `dashboard`, `view`) → `{drafts: []}`; uninstalled package with a bound draft is served and, under another type filter, answers empty; listing unreadable or shapeless → fail-open empty; no package named → listing never asked.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-drafts-unknown-filter.test.ts` (9): four misspellings → 400 equal to `GET /meta/:type`'s body for the same name, `listDrafts` never called; controls `dashboard`/`dashboards`/`view` → 200 empty with the arguments `listDrafts` received; known package → 200 empty; the package refusal leaves the route a 400 `INVALID_REQUEST`.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-drafts-unknown-type.test.ts` (7): the dispatcher twin, same pins against its own list branch.

## Acceptance notes

- `?package=` (the card's wording in one place) is not a `_drafts` parameter; the route reads `packageId` and the console sends `packageId`. Unknown parameter names on `_drafts` are not refused today (no closed set declared); out of scope here.
- Console consumer reading (`ui/packages/app-shell`, 20 `listDrafts` call sites): every call that sends `type` pairs it with `client.list(type)` on `GET /meta/:type`, which already refuses the same names with the same verdict, so the new check refuses nothing the console's paired read does not already refuse. The literal types sent (`view`, `hook`, `object`, `app`, `permission`) all pass the static contract. `packageId` comes from the Studio package switcher, which lists `/api/v1/packages` (installed packages); most call sites also `.catch` the drafts read.

- runtime: same four — `expected 200 to be 400`; 4 failed | 3 passed (7).

Every refusal pin red on base, every control green. Tests import their package's `src`; no dist resolution in these paths.
